title: 第一百五十二章兵败如山倒天魔老祖第一百五十一章天刀门灭
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: “他到底是什么人，竟拥有万魂宗的千万魂幡。”大乘初期二长老捏了把冷汗。
渡劫巅峰三长老：“据我所知，万魂宗老祖陨落，都封山了，七杆魂幡全都遗失。”
说到这，大长老的瞳孔猛地一缩：“你是天魔老祖？”
这个消息他们是从血杀殿口中打探得知。
安浩圣子和万魂宗六大长老、圣子万九阴全都是当天死的。
其中风头最盛的就是天魔老祖。
抛去紫霄圣地那张扬跋扈的性格，他们看不上邪修的手段。
唯有此人。
“你们倒是有点脑子，居然能够认出本座。”
“我的目的很简单，将安逸一脉的所有人交出来，剩下的人我不为难，给你们三息的时间考虑。”
李长寿本想让整个安家陪葬，奈何安如雪念记血脉旧情，不愿看着血流成河，家族毁灭。
作为宠妻狂魔，只好退而求其次，就灭他一脉的所有人吧！
“哈哈哈，家主一脉是我们安家的最强者，我还以为天魔老祖有多厉害，原来是个没有任何思维的土鳖。”
“纵然你杀了万魂宗的长老又如何，我们老祖可是大乘巅峰的存在，岂是那些货色能比的。”
“兄弟们，家主曾经有言，只要提供天魔老祖的信息奖励百亿灵石，参与击杀奖励千亿，要是能够把他弄死就奖励万亿，立功的机会就在眼前啊！”
安家弟子想起这个消息，立刻变得精神了起来。
活脱脱的像是如狼似虎的少妇盯着一只白斩鸡。
冤魂的阵仗确实可怕，可他们安家也不是好惹的。
反正有老祖压阵，就算打不过参与灭个冤魂也能获得海量灵石。
“既然你们找死，那就尽管来吧！”
说罢，李长寿操控冤魂大军和安家弟子发生大战。
“杀！”三长老大喝一声，一马当先冲了出去。
枯木之力形成一只巨大木人，一息之间轰死上千只冤魂。
其他安家弟子看到长老这般英勇，体内的一腔热血瞬间被点燃。
轰的一声冲了出去。
各种神通在虚空中大放异彩。
万人安家弟子对战数千万的冤魂，尽管这样，他们依旧没有退让。
反而是因为都是安家弟子，功法高度一致，打出了配合，歼灭了不少冤魂。
直到一只大乘期的雷光狼王出现，打破了他们的优势。
雷霆漩涡覆盖方圆万里，攻击范围相当之广。
无论的安家弟子和冤魂都在举手投足间湮灭。
无数惨叫声整齐划一，一具具尸体如落汤鸡般从虚空中掉在地上。
好在尊魂幡上有冤魂的真灵，不过一刻钟的时间就已经全部复苏，加入战场。
“该死，怎么会有大乘期的冤魂。”被打飞的三长老咂了咂嘴，忍不住吐槽。
“这才哪到哪，那尊千万魂幡中至少还有着万魂宗的一名老祖级人物，这也就代表着咱们少说要应对两尊大乘期。”大长老安爽目光警惕。
“不行，不能让他再猖狂下去，大哥，咱们一起先挡住这两尊大乘冤魂。”二长老看到弟子身死，有些急切。
“不用做无意义的事情，咱们就算灭了这两只大乘期冤魂，他们也会在尊魂幡中复活。”安爽深谋远虑：“擒贼先擒王，先抓住那名合体期的蝼蚁，一切都可迎刃而解。”
有了大长老的分析，二长老和三长老这才茅塞顿开。
他们对抗尊魂幡中的冤魂很困难，或许有陨落的风险。

"Who is he? He actually owns the Ten Thousand Soul Flags of the Ten Thousand Souls Sect." The second elder of the early Mahayana period broke out in a cold sweat.
The third elder at the peak of the Tribulation: "As far as I know, the ancestor of the Ten Thousand Souls Sect died, the mountains were closed, and all seven soul flags were lost."
Speaking of this, the great elder's pupils shrank suddenly: "Are you the ancestor of the demon?"
They learned this news from the Blood Killing Hall.
Holy Son An Hao, the six elders of Wanhun Sect, and Holy Son Wan Jiuyin all died on the same day.
Among them, the most popular one is the Demon Ancestor.
Putting aside the domineering character of Zixiao Holy Land, they looked down upon the methods of evil cultivators.
Only this person.
"You guys have some brains and can actually recognize me."
"My purpose is very simple. I will hand over everyone from An Yi's lineage. I will not embarrass the remaining people and give you three breaths to think about it."
Li Changshou originally wanted the entire An family to be buried with him, but An Ruxue remembered the old blood relationship and did not want to watch the blood flow into a river and the family be destroyed.
As a maniac who dotes on his wife, he has no choice but to do the next best thing and destroy everyone in his lineage!
"Hahaha, the family leader's lineage is the strongest in our An family. I thought the ancestor of the demon was so powerful, but it turns out he is just a country bumpkin without any thinking."
"So what if you kill the elders of the Ten Thousand Souls Sect? Our ancestors are at the pinnacle of the Mahayana. How can they be compared to those guys?"
"Brothers, the head of the family once said that as long as you provide information about the ancestor of the demon, you will be rewarded with tens of billions of spirit stones, and if you participate in the killing, you will be rewarded with hundreds of billions. If you can kill him, you will be rewarded with trillions. The opportunity to make a contribution is right in front of you!"
The disciples of the An family immediately became energetic when they thought of the news.
She looks like a wolf-like young woman staring at a white chicken.
The battle of innocent souls is indeed terrifying, but Anjia is not someone to be trifled with.
Anyway, with the ancestors holding the battle, even if you can't defeat them and participate in killing an innocent soul, you can still get a large amount of spiritual stones.
"Since you are looking for death, then go ahead!"
After that, Li Changshou controlled the army of wronged souls to fight against the disciples of the An family.
"Kill!" The third elder shouted and rushed out first.
The power of the dead wood formed a huge wooden man, killing thousands of innocent souls in one breath.
When the other An family disciples saw the elder's bravery, the blood in their bodies was instantly ignited.
He rushed out with a bang.
Various magical powers shine in the void.
Thousands of An family disciples fought against tens of millions of innocent souls. Despite this, they still did not give in.
On the contrary, it was because they were all disciples of the An family and their techniques were highly consistent, so they cooperated and annihilated many wronged souls.
Until a Thunder Wolf King in the Mahayana stage appeared and broke their advantage.
The thunder vortex covers a radius of thousands of miles, and the attack range is quite wide.
All the disciples and innocent souls of the An family were annihilated in the blink of an eye.
Countless screams were heard in unison, and corpses fell from the void to the ground like drowned rats.
Fortunately, there were true spirits of wronged souls on the Soul Reverend Flag, and within a quarter of an hour they had all revived and joined the battlefield.
"Damn it, how could there be an innocent soul from the Mahayana period?" The third elder who was knocked away smacked his lips and couldn't help complaining.
"What's going on here? There is at least an ancestor of the Ten Thousand Souls Sect in the Ten Thousand Souls Banner. This means that we have to deal with two Mahayana figures at least." The Great Elder An Shuang's eyes were alert.
"No, we can't let him continue to be rampant. Brother, let's stop these two Mahayana ghosts together first." The second elder was a little anxious when he saw his disciple dead.
"There's no need to do meaningless things. Even if we kill these two Mahayana-stage enemy souls, they will be resurrected in the soul banner." An Shuang said with great foresight: "To capture the thief, capture the king first, and capture the ant in the Fusion stage first. Everything can be solved easily."
With the analysis of the great elder, the second elder and the third elder suddenly became enlightened.
It will be difficult for them to fight against the wronged souls in the Zunhun Banner, and they may be at risk of falling.
title_en: Chapter 152: Defeated like a mountain and the Heavenly Demon Ancestor fell. Chapter 151: The Heavenly Sword Sect is destroyed.
